products.name: Cisco Wireless CW9176I Wi-Fi 7 Access Point
products.summary: Tri-radio Wi-Fi 7 indoor AP (4x4, 12 spatial streams) with a 10 Gbps mGig port, scan and IoT radios, UWB and GNSS.
products.description: The CW9176I is a high-density indoor Wi-Fi 7 access point. Cisco lists a tri-radio 4x4 design with 12 spatial streams across 2.4/5 GHz, 5 GHz and 6 GHz, a dedicated scan radio and IoT radio, integrated ultra-wideband, built-in GNSS/GPS and a single 10 Gbps mGig port.
products.keywords: cisco wireless meraki cw9176i wifi 7 access point tri radio 6ghz

specs.wifiDetails: Tri-radio 4x4, 12 spatial streams; 2.4/5 GHz, 5 GHz, 6 GHz; scan + IoT radio, UWB, GNSS

products.notes: Cisco publishes no US list price for this product (sold through partners / quote only); price is a TrustKart estimate. No clean model-specific Cisco image found (the product page reuses the CW9178I photo), so no image is set.

products.name: Cisco Secure Firewall 1210CE
products.summary: Compact desktop NGFW with 8x 1GbE ports, 6.5 Gbps firewall and 6 Gbps threat-defense throughput.
products.description: The Secure Firewall 1210CE is the entry desktop model of Cisco's Secure Firewall 1200 Series. Cisco's data sheet lists eight 1000BASE-T ports, 6.5 Gbps firewall throughput, 6.0 Gbps threat defense and IPS throughput and 1.0 Gbps TLS decryption.
products.keywords: cisco secure firewall 1210ce ngfw threat defense ftd
products.notes: Cisco publishes no US list price for this product (sold through partners / quote only); price is a TrustKart estimate. Threat/malware/URL subscriptions are extra. firewallThroughputGbps is Cisco's FW+AVC+IPS (1024B) figure, except 1200/220 models where the threat-defense figure is used. The only official image is an off-white data-sheet front-panel drawing, so no image is set.

products.name: Cisco Secure Firewall 1210CP PoE
products.summary: Compact desktop NGFW with 8x 1GbE ports (4 PoE, 120W) and 6.5 Gbps firewall throughput.
products.description: The Secure Firewall 1210CP is the PoE version of the 1210 desktop firewall. Cisco lists eight 1000BASE-T ports with four PoE ports delivering up to 120W, 6.5 Gbps firewall throughput, 6.0 Gbps threat defense/IPS and 1.0 Gbps TLS decryption.
products.keywords: cisco secure firewall 1210cp ngfw threat defense ftd
products.notes: Cisco publishes no US list price for this product (sold through partners / quote only); price is a TrustKart estimate. Threat/malware/URL subscriptions are extra. firewallThroughputGbps is Cisco's FW+AVC+IPS (1024B) figure, except 1200/220 models where the threat-defense figure is used. The only official image is an off-white data-sheet front-panel drawing, so no image is set.

products.name: Cisco UCS X210c M8 Compute Node
products.summary: Dual-socket Intel Xeon 6 compute node for the UCS X9508 with up to 32 DDR5 DIMMs and 9 E3.S NVMe drives.
products.description: The UCS X210c M8 is a compute node for the UCS X-Series chassis supporting up to two Intel Xeon 6 processors and up to 32 DDR5 DIMMs (RDIMMs up to 6400 MT/s, MRDIMMs up to 8000 MT/s). Front mezzanine options include up to 9 E3.S NVMe drives or 6 SAS/SATA/NVMe drives, or a GPU mezzanine.
products.keywords: cisco ucs x210c m8 compute node blade xeon 6 x-series
products.notes: Cisco publishes no US list price for this product (sold through partners / quote only); price is a TrustKart estimate. Requires a UCS X9508 chassis. No clean official M8 image found (support images show the M6/M7 node), so no image is set.
